name: 20616 · Bryans Road, MD
findings: ZIP 20616 (Bryans Road) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20616 (Bryans Road) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
